system.description:
An advanced set of medical tools for rapidly stabilizing serious injuries. It contains a diagnosis wand to scan the patient to determine the nature and extent of their injuries. This is designed to broadcast the information to a reader lens, making them difficult for non-Weavers to use. Once it has diagnosed the patient, a small assortment of nanotech tissue regenerators and similar devices allow broken bones to be fixed, burnt or torn flesh to be healed, and so forth.

An Emergency Trauma kit can completely heal any single Injury with a successful Insight (Operate) Test with a Difficulty equal to the Injury’s damage rating -2. An Emergency Trauma Kit is powered, and recharges after a Bed rest. Due to the reliance on a reader lens, a non-Weaver attempting to use an Emergency Trauma Kit adds 1 to Threat.
